-- Campaign uplift: Black Week 2025 (campaign 15)
-- Campaign window + 7 days: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-07

WITH campaign_params AS (
  SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, '2025-11-24'::DATE AS window_start, '2025-12-07'::DATE AS window_end
),

-- Get targeted members (those with at least one exposure)
targeted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ce.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
  WHERE ce.campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign_params)
),

-- Get holdout members
holdout_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id
  FROM campaign_holdout
  WHERE campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign_params)
),

-- Sales lines in the campaign window, excluding store 999 and ZZ Test
sales_lines AS (
  SELECT 
    f.member_key,
    m.member_id,
    f.net_amount,
    f.sale_date,
    s.store_id,
    p.category,
    CASE WHEN f.channel_code = 'WB' THEN wo.dispatch_ts_utc ELSE NULL END AS dispatch_ts
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= (SELECT window_start FROM campaign_params)
    AND f.sale_date <= (SELECT window_end FROM campaign_params)
    AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),

-- Date adjustment for web sales (dispatch date in Helsinki time)
sales_with_date AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    net_amount,
    CASE 
      WHEN dispatch_ts IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(dispatch_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)
      ELSE sale_date
    END AS sale_reporting_date
  FROM sales_lines
  WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Net sales per member within the campaign window
member_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    member_id,
    SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_sales
  FROM sales_with_date
  GROUP BY member_id
),

-- Join members to their sales
targeted_with_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    tm.member_id,
    COALESCE(ms.total_net_sales, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM targeted_members tm
  LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON tm.member_id = ms.member_id
),

holdout_with_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    hm.member_id,
    COALESCE(ms.total_net_sales, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM holdout_members hm
  LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON hm.member_id = ms.member_id
),

-- Calculate means
targeted_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_sales) AS avg_spend FROM targeted_with_sales
),

holdout_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_sales) AS avg_spend FROM holdout_with_sales
)

SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(net_sales) FROM targeted_with_sales) AS avg_spend_targeted_member,
  (SELECT AVG(net_sales) FROM holdout_with_sales) AS avg_spend_holdout_member,
  (SELECT AVG(net_sales) FROM targeted_with_sales) - (SELECT AVG(net_sales) FROM holdout_with_sales) AS uplift_euros
